clips.title: The story
paras: In Darkshore, scouts use the Phial of Scrying to reach Onu from afar. The ancient of lore provides the enchanted vessel, which calls forth a bowl for scrying across corrupted woodlands.

The Phial of Scrying carries mystical waters that form a temporary bowl on the ground. Scouts investigating deep within Darkshore use it for long-distance divination. From perilous places such as the Master's Glaive, they can speak directly with Onu instead of returning to his grove.
